info.title: How to Clear Water From Your Ear
info.subtitle: Safe steps to try, and when to call a professional.

rows.title: Tilt and drain
rows.desc: Face the ear down and let gravity pull water out

rows.title: Tug the earlobe
rows.desc: Gently pull down and back to open the canal

rows.title: Move your jaw
rows.desc: Yawn or chew to shift trapped water loose

rows.title: Warm air or drops
rows.desc: Low-heat dryer or OTC drying drops finish it

rows.title: Know the red flags
rows.desc: Pain, drainage, or fever means see a pro
